Join our team

Bring your curiosity.

Good research benefits from different ways of seeing. We welcome thoughtful people who enjoy working through difficult questions together.

Work with intention

Space to think.
People to think with.

We value people who can ask a clear question, listen carefully, and explain how they arrived at an answer. A willingness to revise an idea matters as much as the confidence to propose it.

Research and engineering are closely connected here. The problems we care about benefit from a range of disciplines and a shared respect for careful work.

Areas of interest

Where disciplines meet.

Quantitative research

Mathematical reasoning, statistical thinking, and the design of thoughtful experiments.

Research engineering

Reproducible tooling, dependable systems, and the connection between ideas and implementation.

Data & infrastructure

Careful data foundations, clear interfaces, and systems that make research easier to inspect.
